channel_mix: Product-led sharing, YouTube/TikTok/LinkedIn/X, affiliate, 150+ creators monthly, events/community
creator_tiers: Micro-influencers through celebrities; dedicated global creator lead
campaign_rhythm: Always-on monthly creator volume plus product launches
operator_model: Dedicated creator partnerships, growth marketing, creative and partner leads
selection_logic: Audience/brand fit and multi-platform fluency; archived job emphasizes authentic long-term relationships
relationship_compounding: Founder-led early onboarding evolved into repeat creator posting and a scaled operating team
mango_takeaway: Replicate the localized operator layer and creator QA; do not try to match Gamma's total spend.

channel_mix: Paid YouTube, affiliate, ambassadors, Discord, events, artists/entertainment partnerships and international GTM
creator_tiers: Open affiliate base, ambassador community, paid specialist creators, entertainment talent
campaign_rhythm: Evergreen affiliate links plus launch-specific sponsorships and community events
partner_program: PartnerStack affiliate; Ambassador content and community tracks
operator_model: Separate influencer/affiliate, social growth, regional growth and entertainment partnership roles
selection_logic: Demonstrated product use and educational content; official case study favors helpful evergreen workflows
relationship_compounding: Top affiliates become official case studies; ambassadors get direct support and can unlock paid work
mango_takeaway: Start with product-using regional educators and attach affiliate attribution before scaling sponsorships.

channel_mix: X, TikTok, YouTube, Product Hunt, UGC, hackathons, integrations and co-marketing
creator_tiers: Users/builders, educators, tracked affiliates and partner brands
campaign_rhythm: Launch bursts amplified by continuous user project sharing
operator_model: Head of Partner Marketing, Partner Marketing Lead, Head of Growth and campaign/brand roles
selection_logic: Creators who can build real projects and show business outcomes
relationship_compounding: Community/project showcases create reusable proof; integrations give both partners distribution
mango_takeaway: Sell a build-and-distribute system with real deployed products, not standalone sponsored posts.

channel_mix: Creators, education, hackathons, partner co-marketing, enterprise alliances, marketplaces and build-in-public content
creator_tiers: Threshold-qualified content creators, educators, developer advocates and solution partners
campaign_rhythm: Programmatic always-on creator intake plus time-boxed challenges and launches
partner_program: Creators, Integration, Solution, Government and Education tracks; referral/co-selling
operator_model: Growth Partnerships, VP BD/Partnerships, strategic alliances and DevRel
selection_logic: Clear teaching, authentic building, minimum audience and recent-view thresholds
relationship_compounding: Creators demonstrate shipped apps; partners receive co-marketing and revenue routes
mango_takeaway: Propose an activation-measured builder challenge and show apps created, users activated and qualified teams—not impressions alone.

channel_mix: Community clubs, courses/certifications, LinkedIn executives, events, webinars, agencies/partners and selective out-of-home
creator_tiers: GTM experts, agency operators, community leaders and executives as creators
campaign_rhythm: High-frequency executive distribution plus recurring cohorts, clubs and livestreams
partner_program: Clay Clubs and solution/agency partner ecosystem
operator_model: Head of Marketing builds programs; Growth captures/converts demand; community leads scale local chapters
selection_logic: Qualified engagement from ICP accounts rather than follower count
relationship_compounding: Education creates status; partners get client work; community members produce content and referrals
mango_takeaway: For B2B AI, build operator communities and measure qualified relationships; paid KOL reach is secondary.

channel_mix: Film funds, festivals, creator programs, student ambassadors, global meetups and studio partnerships
creator_tiers: Emerging filmmakers through established studios and industry jurors
campaign_rhythm: Annual/seasonal festivals and funds plus strategic studio activations
partner_program: Creative Partners, Hundred Film Fund, student ambassadors and partnerships inbox
operator_model: Runway Studios plus corporate partnership and operations leadership
selection_logic: Project quality, credible creative intent and professional production potential
relationship_compounding: Funding, screenings, festivals and co-production move creators from tool users into long-term ecosystem partners
mango_takeaway: Works for curated high-quality creative cohorts; requires strong programming and talent credibility, not a commodity influencer list.
